fill_reason.pin_bound: LH-SMATT 10-19: pin- and macro-limited outline. The 1,536-bit inst bus + taps (1,661 W pins) need >=277 um of W face at <=6 pins/um (324 -> 5.1/um); the four delay SRAMs (2x 94.8x80.5 p192_mir + 2x 51.4x40.0 p192_rc, pins on W/E faces <=5.1/um) form one deliberately abutted N-S stack (no pins on N/S macro faces, pitch = height + 0.024, on track) with std-cell bands on both pin faces. Std area ~3.8k um2 -> ~10% fill; a squarer outline would push the W bus over 6 pins/um or split the macro column away from the logic it serves.
